profile.Name: Julius the Fork-Tongued
profile.Personality: Defiant and upbeat despite grim odds, certain his people were made to rule the swamps. He welcomes outsiders and is sure the swamp gangs stand no chance.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Cold Bloods from Raft in the Swamp. His people grew from the survivors of the Reptiloids, who were made for the swamps and then hunted almost to extinction by the United Cities and the Holy Nation. He means for them to rule these lands one day.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rallying cries like "The swamps were made for us!" Admits the deck is stacked against them but says he still likes their odds.
